definition: to get a better job or position in life
description: A busy restaurant kitchen with white tiled walls and copper pans. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey trousers climbs a black iron spiral staircase and reaches up for a white chef's jacket that an older chef holds out to him from the gallery above. Cooks in white jackets and aprons cheer and push him upwards from below, and more cooks on the balcony throw tea towels into the air and clap. Steam rises from large steel pots on the stove.

taps.phrase: to reach up for the jacket
to hold out a chef's jacket
